variables.description: The host port for accessing the n8n web interface.
variables.label: n8n Web UI Port

variables.description: Password for n8n basic authentication. CHANGE THIS IMMEDIATELY!
variables.label: n8n Basic Auth Password

variables.description: The external URL that n8n uses to generate webhook endpoints. This must be accessible from outside the container. For example: http://your-n8n-domain.com or https://your-n8n-domain.com. You can also use a local IP and port (e.g. http://192.168.178.91:5678) if you only use webhooks internally on your local network (LAN) and do not need external triggers from public internet services.
variables.label: n8n Webhook URL

variables.description: Set the timezone for n8n. Example: Europe/Berlin or America/New_York.
variables.label: n8n Timezone
